tool_args.rationale: The open-branch probe resolved the narrow s_grad collinearity with readings at 0.18 and 2.35. The resulting seven points span both drive and gradient, supporting numerical fitting of vmax, rho, and the signed square-root branch coefficient over the full fallback bounds. No observation crosses the stated supercritical threshold.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The added high-gradient observation is s_grad=2.35, below the supplied 2.36 trigger; the observed signature is the smooth monotone-concave branch.
All available observations are same-horizon scalar readouts, while the 7 rows include broad s_grad leverage and allow fitting the 3-parameter static siphon form without unnecessary trajectory cost.
It predicts a downturn at high u_now; the observations instead increase monotonically across the sampled u range, and the supplied base-field/sink-gradient signatures support the siphon mechanism.
